question: Ajit starts from point A and drives 6 km towards North. He then takes two simultaneous left turns and drives 2 km each. He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km.. He then takes a left turn and drives 2 km. He takes a final left tum and drives 5 km to reach a point B. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees tums only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

** **Ajit starts from point A and drives 6 km towards North.

He then takes two simultaneous left turns and drives 2 km each.

He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 2 km.

He takes a final left tum and drives 5 km to reach a point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/add7fa4b7af67c3399b28d35e20651acfd13d65208c41b36740d1aa80f1cb686.png] 

Thus, he drive 2 km South in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
